018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.util.*;

028/**
029 * Test helper that extracts the {@code #juneau-page} contract and {@code <template>} ids from a
030 * rendered console page, validates them against {@link PageContractSchema}, and offers fluent
031 * assertions so adopters assert on the contract instead of on rendered chrome HTML.
032 *
033 * <p>
034 * Failures throw {@link AssertionError}, so the class works under any test framework.
035 *
036 * <p>
037 * {@link #assertPage(String)} also fails immediately if the contract still carries the pre-rename top-level
038 * <c>version</c> key (now <c>contractVersion</c>), even when {@link #isValid()} is never called.
039 *
040 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
041 * <p class='bjava'>
042 *    String <jv>html</jv> = <jv>client</jv>.get(<js>"/slo"</js>).run().getContent().asString();
043 *    PageContractAssert.<jsm>assertPage</jsm>(<jv>html</jv>)
044 *       .isValid()
045 *       .hasContractVersion(<js>"1"</js>)
046 *       .hasActiveNav(<js>"slo"</js>)
047 *       .hasNavPath(<js>"home"</js>, <js>"about"</js>)
048 *       .hasNavHref(<js>"slo"</js>, <js>"/slo"</js>)
049 *       .hasFooterText(<js>"Sandbox Support Console"</js>)
050 *       .hasHeaderSlot(<js>"banner"</js>)
051 *       .hasCard(<js>"releases"</js>, <js>"datatables"</js>)
052 *       .hasCardKey(<js>"releases"</js>, <js>"/table/dataUrl"</js>, <js>"/rest/releases/data"</js>)
053 *       .templateContains(<js>"jc-seg-1"</js>, <js>"id=\"ssc-table-slot\""</js>);
054 *
055 *    PageContractAssert.<jsm>assertPage</jsm>(<jv>html</jv>)
056 *       .subscribes(<js>"tasks"</js>, <js>"selection:changes"</js>, <js>"params"</js>)
057 *       .declaresTopic(<js>"ops.jobs"</js>)
058 *       .hasBridge(<js>"ops"</js>)
059 *       .hasNoWiringErrors();
060 * </p>
061 *
062 * @since 10.0.0
063 */
064public final class PageContractAssert {
065
066   private static final Pattern ISLAND = Pattern.compile(
067      "<script type=\"application/json\" id=\"juneau-page\">(.*?)</script>", Pattern.DOTALL);
068   private static final Pattern TEMPLATE_OPEN = Pattern.compile("<template data-(card|slot)=\"([^\"]+)\">");
069
070   private final String json;
071   private final JsonMap contract;
072   private final Map<String,String> templates;
073
074   private PageContractAssert(String html) {
075      var m = ISLAND.matcher(html);
076      if (! m.find())
077         throw new AssertionError("no <script type=\"application/json\" id=\"juneau-page\"> in page");
078      json = m.group(1);
079      try {
080         contract = JsonMap.ofString(json);
081      } catch (Exception e) {
082         throw new AssertionError("unparseable page contract: " + e.getMessage(), e);
083      }
084      if (contract.containsKey("version"))
085         throw new AssertionError("page contract key 'version' was renamed to 'contractVersion'; regenerate the page with a current Juneau");
086      templates = scanTemplates(html);
087   }
088
089   /**
090    * Parses the contract and templates out of a rendered page.
091    *
092    * @param html The full rendered page.
093    * @return A new assertion object.
094    * @throws AssertionError If the page has no parseable contract island.
095    */
096   public static PageContractAssert assertPage(String html) {
097      return new PageContractAssert(html);
098   }
099
100   /**
101    * Asserts the contract passes the schema and rules R-1..R-4.
102    *
103    * @return This object.
104    */
105   public PageContractAssert isValid() {
106      var errors = PageContractSchema.get().validate(json, templates.keySet());
107      if (! errors.isEmpty())
108         throw new AssertionError("page contract is invalid:\n" + String.join("\n", errors));
109      return this;
110   }
111
112   /** @param v The expected contract version. @return This object. */
113   public PageContractAssert hasContractVersion(String v) {
114      return eq("contractVersion", v, contract.getString("contractVersion"));
115   }

123   public PageContractAssert hasTheme(String name) {
124      var t = contract.getMap("theme");
125      return eq("theme.name", name, t == null ? null : t.getString("name"));
126   }

128   /** @param idPath The expected active path, root first. @return This object. */
129   public PageContractAssert hasActiveNav(String... idPath) {
130      var actual = strings(contract.getList("activeNav"));
131      if (! actual.equals(List.of(idPath)))
132         throw new AssertionError("activeNav: expected " + List.of(idPath) + " but was " + actual);
133      return this;
134   }
135
136   /** Asserts {@code activeNav} is empty (the JS prefix fallback applies). @return This object. */
137   public PageContractAssert hasNoActiveNav() {
138      var actual = strings(contract.getList("activeNav"));
139      if (! actual.isEmpty())
140         throw new AssertionError("activeNav: expected [] but was " + actual);
141      return this;
142   }
143
144   /** @param idPath A root-first id path that must exist in {@code nav}. @return This object. */
145   public PageContractAssert hasNavPath(String... idPath) {
146      if (idPath.length == 0)
147         throw new AssertionError("hasNavPath() requires at least one path segment");
148      node(List.of(idPath));
149      return this;
150   }
151
152   /**
153    * @param id A node id, or a {@code /}-separated id path such as {@code "home/about"}.
154    * @param href The expected href.
155    * @return This object.
156    */
157   public PageContractAssert hasNavHref(String id, String href) {
158      var n = node(List.of(id.split("/")));
159      if (neq(href, n.getString("href")))
160         throw new AssertionError("nav '" + id + "' href: expected '" + href + "' but was '" + n.getString("href") + "'");
161      return this;
162   }
163
164   /**
165    * @param idPath A {@code /}-separated id path.
166    * @param childIds The expected child ids, in order.
167    * @return This object.
168    */
169   public PageContractAssert hasNavChildren(String idPath, String... childIds) {
170      var n = node(List.of(idPath.split("/")));
171      var kids = n.getList("children");
172      var actual = kids == null ? List.<String>of() : kids.stream().map(k -> ((JsonMap)k).getString("id")).toList();
173      if (! actual.equals(List.of(childIds)))
174         throw new AssertionError("nav '" + idPath + "' children: expected " + List.of(childIds) + " but was " + actual);
175      return this;
176   }
177

179   public PageContractAssert hasHeaderTitle(String v) {

181      return eq("header.title", v, h == null ? null : h.getString("title"));
182   }

220   /** @param cardId The card id. @param topic A topic the card must subscribe to. @return This object. */

223      return this;

226   /**
227    * @param cardId The card id.
228    * @param topic A topic the card must subscribe to.
229    * @param role The role it must be wired to.

237   /** @param cardId The card id. @param topic A custom topic the card must declare in {@code publishes}. @return This object. */
238   public PageContractAssert publishes(String cardId, String topic) {
239      var topics = topicsOf(card(cardId).getList("publishes"));

245   /** @param topic A top-level {@code topics} entry that must exist. @return This object. */
246   public PageContractAssert declaresTopic(String topic) {

253   /** @param id A top-level {@code bridges} id that must exist. @return This object. */
254   public PageContractAssert hasBridge(String id) {
255      var ids = new ArrayList<String>();
256      var l = contract.getList("bridges");
257      if (l != null)
258         for (var o : l)
259            ids.add(((JsonMap)o).getString("id"));
260      if (! ids.contains(id))
261         throw new AssertionError("no bridge '" + id + "'; bridges: " + ids);
262      return this;
263   }

265   /**
266    * Runs R-10 and R-11 against the standard card-type registry. Pair it with {@code BusPolicy.check(contract())}
267    * (juneau-rest-server-bus) for the server-grant side (E-55). A page with custom card types needs the
268    * {@link #hasNoWiringErrors(CardTypeRegistry)} overload with the registry that knows them.
269    *
270    * @return This object.
271    */
272   public PageContractAssert hasNoWiringErrors() {
273      return hasNoWiringErrors(CardTypeRegistry.standard());
274   }
275
276   /** @param registry The registry that knows the page's card types. @return This object. */
277   public PageContractAssert hasNoWiringErrors(CardTypeRegistry registry) {
278      var problems = BusWiringValidator.validate(contract, registry);
279      if (! problems.isEmpty())
280         throw new AssertionError("page wiring has errors:\n"
281            + problems.stream().map(p -> p.code() + " " + p.message()).collect(Collectors.joining("\n")));
282      return this;
283   }
284
285   private JsonMap subscription(String cardId, String topic, String role) {
286      var l = card(cardId).getList("subscribes");
287      var roles = new ArrayList<String>();
288      if (l != null)
289         for (var o : l) {
290            var m = (JsonMap)o;
291            if (! topic.equals(m.getString("topic")))
292               continue;
293            if (role == null || role.equals(m.getString("as")))
294               return m;
295            roles.add(m.getString("as"));
296         }
297      if (! roles.isEmpty())
298         throw new AssertionError("card '" + cardId + "' subscribes to '" + topic + "' as " + roles + ", not '" + role + "'");
299      throw new AssertionError("card '" + cardId + "' does not subscribe to '" + topic + "'; subscribes: " + topicsOf(l));
300   }
301
302   private static List<String> topicsOf(List<?> l) {
303      var out = new ArrayList<String>();
304      if (l != null)
305         for (var o : l)
306            out.add(((JsonMap)o).getString("topic"));
307      return out;
308   }

328         throw new AssertionError("card '" + id + "' " + jsonPointer + ": expected '" + expected + "' but was '" + actual + "'");
329      return this;
330   }

333    * @param templateId A {@code data-card} or {@code data-slot} template id.

337   public PageContractAssert templateContains(String templateId, String fragment) {

343   /**
344    * Asserts this page and another render the same contract and the same template markup.
345    *
346    * <p>
347    * Use it to prove two ways of producing a page (for example a hand-written template and its builder twin) agree.
348    * The contracts are compared as key-sorted JSON; list order is kept, because card, nav and option order is part of
349    * the page.  Templates are compared by id on their {@linkplain String#strip() stripped} markup, so the whitespace a
350    * template author's layout puts around a card body does not count.
351    *
352    * <p>
353    * The failure message names the first difference, for example
354    * {@code page contracts differ at $.cards[0].bare: this=true other=false}.
355    *
356    * @param other The page this one must equal.
357    * @return This object.
358    */
359   public PageContractAssert isTwinOf(PageContractAssert other) {
360      assertTwins(contract, templates, other.contract, other.templates);
361      return this;
362   }
363
364   /**
365    * Asserts two contract and template pairs are twins, as {@link #isTwinOf(PageContractAssert)} does.
366    *
367    * <p>
368    * Exposed so a test that must first adjust either side (for example remove a card known to differ) can still use the
369    * shared comparison.
370    *
371    * @param contract The first contract.
372    * @param templates The first page's templates, by id.
373    * @param otherContract The second contract.
374    * @param otherTemplates The second page's templates, by id.
375    * @throws AssertionError If the contracts or templates differ.
376    */
377   public static void assertTwins(Map<?,?> contract, Map<String,String> templates, Map<?,?> otherContract, Map<String,String> otherTemplates) {
378      var diff = firstDiff("$", canonical(contract), canonical(otherContract));
379      if (diff != null)
380         throw new AssertionError("page contracts differ at " + diff);
381      var a = stripped(templates);
382      var b = stripped(otherTemplates);
383      var ids = new TreeSet<>(a.keySet());
384      ids.addAll(b.keySet());
385      for (var id : ids)
386         if (neq(a.get(id), b.get(id)))
387            throw new AssertionError("page template '" + id + "' differs: this=" + a.get(id) + " other=" + b.get(id));
388   }
389
390   private static Map<String,String> stripped(Map<String,String> templates) {
391      var out = new TreeMap<String,String>();
392      templates.forEach((k, v) -> out.put(k, v.strip()));
393      return out;
394   }
395
396   // Recursively key-sorts every Map; List order is kept.
397   private static Object canonical(Object v) {
398      if (v instanceof Map<?,?> m) {
399         var out = new TreeMap<String,Object>();
400         m.forEach((k, x) -> out.put(String.valueOf(k), canonical(x)));
401         return out;
402      }
403      if (v instanceof List<?> l)
404         return l.stream().map(PageContractAssert::canonical).toList();
405      return v;
406   }
407
408   // The first place two canonical trees differ, or null.
409   private static String firstDiff(String path, Object a, Object b) {
410      if (! neq(a, b))
411         return null;
412      if (a instanceof Map<?,?> x && b instanceof Map<?,?> y) {
413         var keys = new TreeSet<Object>(x.keySet());
414         keys.addAll(y.keySet());
415         for (var k : keys) {
416            var d = firstDiff(path + "." + k, x.get(k), y.get(k));
417            if (d != null)
418               return d;
419         }
420      }
421      if (a instanceof List<?> x && b instanceof List<?> y && x.size() == y.size())
422         for (var i = 0; i < x.size(); i++) {
423            var d = firstDiff(path + "[" + i + "]", x.get(i), y.get(i));
424            if (d != null)
425               return d;
426         }
427      return path + ": this=" + a + " other=" + b;
428   }

446   /**
447    * @param templateId A {@code data-card} or {@code data-slot} template id.
448    * @return The template's inner markup.
449    */
450   public String template(String templateId) {
451      var t = templates.get(templateId);
452      if (t == null)
453         throw new AssertionError("no <template data-card|data-slot=\"" + templateId + "\">; templates: " + templates.keySet());

457   private PageContractAssert eq(String what, String expected, String actual) {
458      if (neq(expected, actual))
459         throw new AssertionError(what + ": expected '" + expected + "' but was '" + actual + "'");
460      return this;
461   }
462
463   private PageContractAssert slot(String scope, String name) {
464      var sec = contract.getMap(scope);
465      var slots = sec == null ? null : sec.getMap("slots");
466      if (slots == null || ! slots.containsKey(name))
467         throw new AssertionError(scope + ".slots has no '" + name + "'");
468      return this;
469   }
470
471   private JsonMap node(List<String> path) {
472      var level = contract.getList("nav");
473      JsonMap found = null;
474      for (var id : path) {
475         found = null;
476         if (level != null)
477            for (var o : level)
478               if (id.equals(((JsonMap)o).getString("id")))
479                  found = (JsonMap)o;
480         if (found == null)
481            throw new AssertionError("nav path " + path + " not found (failed at '" + id + "')");
482         level = found.getList("children");
483      }
484      return found;
485   }
486
487   /**
488    * @param id The card id.
489    * @return The card's parsed JSON.
490    */
491   public JsonMap card(String id) {
492      for (var o : contract.getList("cards"))
493         if (id.equals(((JsonMap)o).getString("id")))
494            return (JsonMap)o;
495      throw new AssertionError("no card '" + id + "'; cards: " + cardIds());
496   }
497
498   private List<String> cardIds() {
499      return contract.getList("cards").stream().map(o -> ((JsonMap)o).getString("id")).toList();
500   }
501
502   private static Object resolvePointer(Object node, String pointer) {
503      if (pointer.isEmpty())
504         return node;
505      if (! pointer.startsWith("/"))
506         throw new AssertionError("json pointer '" + pointer + "' must start with '/'");
507      var cur = node;
508      for (var raw : pointer.substring(1).split("/", -1)) {
509         var seg = raw.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~");
510         if (cur instanceof Map<?,?> m) {
511            cur = m.get(seg);
512         } else if (cur instanceof List<?> l) {
513            var idx = Integer.parseInt(seg);
514            cur = idx >= 0 && idx < l.size() ? l.get(idx) : null;
515         } else {
516            throw new AssertionError("json pointer '" + pointer + "' hit a leaf before '" + seg + "'; node was: " + cur);
517         }
518      }
519      return cur;
520   }
521
522   private static List<String> strings(List<?> l) {
523      return l == null ? List.of() : l.stream().map(String::valueOf).toList();
524   }
525
526   // Depth-aware: page markup may itself contain <template> elements.
527   private static Map<String,String> scanTemplates(String html) {
528      var out = new LinkedHashMap<String,String>();
529      var m = TEMPLATE_OPEN.matcher(html);
530      var from = 0;
531      while (m.find(from)) {
532         var start = m.end();
533         var depth = 1;
534         var i = start;
535         while (depth > 0) {
536            var open = html.indexOf("<template", i);
537            var close = html.indexOf("</template>", i);
538            if (close < 0)
539               throw new AssertionError("unterminated <template data-" + m.group(1) + "=\"" + m.group(2) + "\">");
540            if (open >= 0 && open < close) {
541               depth++;
542               i = open + 9;
543            } else {
544               depth--;
545               i = close + 11;
546            }
547         }
548         out.put(m.group(2), html.substring(start, i - 11));
549         from = i;
550      }
551      return out;
552   }
553}
